label: HAS_WILL_1: Will is the inclination of an intellectual nature toward the good apprehended through…
term: has will (ST I q.19; Lean parameter `HasWill` of `GodHasWill`)
definition: Will is the inclination of an intellectual nature toward the good apprehended through an intelligible form: seeking it when absent and resting in it when possessed (ST I q.19 a.1). Divine will is not a lack seeking satisfaction: Aquinas says it always possesses its good. HasWill is a primitive predicate in GodHasWill and ClassicalAttributesSuffice.
note: WillFollowsIntellectReading formalizes HasIntellect x → HasWill x, not the internal structure of intellectual appetite or divine choice. The source supplies the intended meaning; no equivalence definition of HasWill is added.
